treaty_name: Convention between the Portuguese Republic and the Hellenic Republic for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (1999)
eif_quote: Greece MLI deposit list: 'Portugal Original 02-12-1999 13-08-2002' (Portugal MLI list identical: 'Greece Original 02-12-1999 13-08-2002')
source_title: Diário da República I Série-A n.º 79, 4.4.2002, pp. 3055 ff. — Resolução da AR n.º 25/2002 with Convention PT–GR (copy of the official DR PDF hosted by a third party, newco.pro — secondary host)

rates.quote: mas se o beneficiário efectivo dos dividendos for um residente do outro Estado Contratante, o imposto assim estabelecido não excederá 15% do montante bruto desses dividendos.
mas se o beneficiário efectivo dos juros for residente do outro Estado Contratante, o imposto assim estabelecido não excederá 15% do montante bruto dos juros.
mas se o beneficiário efectivo das royalties for residente do outro Estado Contratante, a imposto assim estabelecido não excederá 10% do montante bruto das royalties.

ppt.quote: Pursuant to Article 7(17)(a) of the Convention, the Hellenic Republic considers that the following agreements ... contain a provision described in Article 7(2) ... 46 Portugal Articles 11(7) and 12(7)

notes: Single dividend tier (15%), no participation reduction in the treaty. Art. 27(2): withholding taxes on income arising on or after 1 January of the calendar year following entry into force (2003-01-01). Treaty anti-abuse clauses Arts. 11(7)/12(7) replaced by MLI Art. 7(1) PPT. MLI: Greece reserved Art. 8 entirely; PPT effective 2022-01-01 per treaty map. EIF date from OECD MLI positions (Aviso n.º 85/2002 not read). EU directives not modelled.
